$comment: Which D1 database holds which rank. Read by the Python exporter (file naming + import-d1.sh) and mirrored by src/db/shard.ts (bindings). A rank may be split across several databases by the bucket of its id hash: bucket = parseInt(hash[0], 16) % buckets (4 buckets split the 16 hex digits evenly). Everything not listed lives in the main database. Rank 6 (42.5 M quivers) is split in four so each shard's initial load (~42 M row-writes with the trimmed index set, scripts/trim-shard-indexes.sh) fits one month's 50 M included D1 writes.
